entry.prompt: Wide low elven fruit bush: a dome of three fused chunky rounded lobes, wider than tall, studded all over its top and sides with about twenty big round fruits like golden plums, each a clear separate smooth sphere half sunk into the foliage and easy to see from above. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism that reads from above. Solid closed volumes, no individual leaves, hard edges, flat faces. About 1.6 m wide and 1.1 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no basket, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Foliage: deep blue-teal (#2F6F6A) with lighter teal lobe tops (#5E9E92), darker and bluer than the green lawn around it. Fruits: luminous pale gold (#F2D46A) with warm white highlights, the brightest colour on the model and clearly visible from above. No flowers, no text or logos.
